result:
Both parts are implemented: the traditional list on the four carta pages and 16 dish pages. I haven't run a build or looked at a browser render.

## Changed paths
- **`src/components/composition/MenuCollection.astro`** (rewritten):
  - Each row has its own category line, the name as a link, a leader and price, and the bound description. A "Ver plato →" link follows.
  - The name and "Ver plato" both go to `dishRoute(root,id)`.
  - There are no photos or accordions, and the old "Elegir este plato" link is gone from the list.
  - The `data-offering-id`, `data-offering-scope` and `data-search` attributes and the hidden tools block are kept as they were. The existing client files are untouched.
  - The old visible `h2` and intro paragraph are now a visually hidden `h2`, plus a one-line note that recipes, prices and photos are fictional.
- **`src/design/menu-carta.css`** (replaced): one list structure with four skins.
  - 01 ledger: Georgia and dotted leaders.
  - 02 front-page: condensed uppercase names, heavy rules, and an accent category bar.
  - 03 frames: Syne names with ember prices and a button-style "Ver plato".
  - 04 plate: Bodoni names with italic categories.
  - Links are 44px, and rows keep a 16px body and 360px-safe wrapping. The leader hides under 480px.
- **`src/components/composition/DishDetail.astro`** (new):
  - Content: one H1 plus the bound category, price and description, and the photo via `ContextualImage` with `loadDishMedia().handle`, inline credit, slot `offering_media[id]`. It also shows every ingredients, allergens, calories and currency fact with its original ids, and a fiction note.
  - Video: the block appears only if `dishVideo()` returns something. It is native `controls muted playsinline preload="none"` with the poster and no autoplay or loop. It carries `data-dish-video`, `data-media-usage` and `data-dish-media-sha256`. Below it come the label, "Vídeo ilustrativo; no corresponde a esta receta.", and the credit with its source link.
  - Navigation: "Volver a la carta", `pedidos/?plato=<id>`, and "Otros platos" links (name and price) in cyclic order.
- **`src/design/dish-detail.css`** (new): shared layout for the four worlds.
  - It is single-column on mobile. From 900px the photo sits on the right.
  - It includes visible focus rings, 44–48px targets, and small per-world tweaks.
- **`src/components/composition/ExperienceComposition.astro`**:
  - Adds the optional `offering` prop. With it, the route is `dishRoute(...)`, the page kind and class are `dish`/`page-dish`, and the title is the dish name.
  - The breadcrumb is Inicio › La carta › dish, and the dish branch comes before `ArtisticPages`.
  - The detail CSS is emitted only with an offering, and `menuLayout` only when it is the collection page without one. `MenuCollection` is now called with `root`.
- **`src/components/composition/ArtisticPages.astro`**: passes `root={p.root}` to `MenuCollection`.
- **`src/components/composition/ExperienceNavigation.astro`**: an optional `parentKind` prop gives `aria-current="true"` on Carta for dish pages. Old routes produce the same output as before.
- **`src/pages/b3/[candidate]/carta/[dish].astro`** (new):
  - It builds 16 paths from the real menu offerings.
  - It throws if the offering ids are not exactly the four supported ones.
  - It calls `dishRoute` to validate each route and passes the existing collection descriptor.

## Decisions
- `ContextualModule`, pedidos, the footer, the client scripts and the shared CSS are not modified.
- The detail page has no `data-offering-id`, so the list-filtering clients can't match it. It uses `data-dish` and `data-offering-scope` instead.
- I used `p` elements for the facts, as the old detail section did. I did not add labels or health claims.

## Risks and uncertainties
- **Media pins:** the detail pages call `loadDishMedia()`, which throws `DISH_MEDIA_NOT_PINNED` until Codex finishes the pins. Those 16 pages can't build before then.
- **Skin tokens:** the 02, 03 and 04 skins rely on `--accent`, `--action`, `--on-action` and `--display` from each world's existing CSS. I didn't verify those values for each tone. The `#fff` on `--accent` in the 02 category bar and the contrast of 03's orange on black need a check.
- **Image sizes:** `ContextualImage`'s `sizes` hint is tuned for the old cards, so the photo may fetch a larger or smaller source than needed on detail pages.
- **Empty search:** I didn't check whether the refinement client shows an empty state with the new rows. It was untouched, so it should behave as before.
- **ExperienceComposition:** I assumed `lab.presentation.offering_order` and `offering_media` are the same on every profile. The offering ids in `context.json` match the dish ids.
- **Widths:** I haven't checked 360/390/768/1024/1440 layouts, word breaks or whether the 03 left rail overlaps the content. Those need your browser checks.
- **Old carta pages:** they now contain no photos, so any audit expecting a photo on the carta page may flag it. You authorised removing them.
